summary.zh: 定位 MCP 连接器的鉴权失效原因
summary.en: Diagnose why an MCP connector's authentication stopped working.

description.zh: 针对原本能连的 MCP 连接器突然返回 401、刷新令牌后失效或读到其他账号数据等问题，先判断故障落在哪一环，再决定是否改代码。适合排查鉴权异常，不用于新接入。需要提供连接器配置和失败日志。
description.en: Works out which step broke when a healthy MCP connector starts returning 401s, fails after a token refresh or serves another account's data. Run it before touching code. Meant for auth failures, not new integrations; bring config and logs.
